root_review_fix.issue: The first sink draft keyed plan_id by decision.evaluation_id. A changed evaluation_id for the same actual execution could select a new key.
root_review_fix.resolution: Final publication_key uses StableId::new(execution_digest.to_string()) and domain binding(owner_binding,execution_digest); evaluation_id remains in the committed payload. The same execution with any changed decision bytes hits the same immutable key and rejects. No original durable-store change.
root_review_fix.additional_original_store_observation: An Indeterminate claim/readback retains original concrete store.poisoned sticky state. The sink preserves this mechanism rather than replacing original failure semantics.

semantics: The exact file bytes are hashed into the actual frozen final_holdout_digest before evaluation. The codec does not embed the complete sealed plan digest, avoiding a circular hash dependency.
File open validates original plan integrity, regular file, shared OS lock, bounded length and exact digest. manifest_digest never releases decoded rows.

A valid release permit is consumed once even on binding/decoding failure. It binds the complete expected sealed plan and original Recorded receipt. The original durable holdout journal refuses replay before any later provider release.

The permit attests only the original runner control-flow point. The original generic CAS backend remains a host-authenticated capability; the actual production adapter must use the existing concrete LockedFileFinalHoldoutCasStoreV1.
The sink owns a separate real locked file store with a domain-separated namespace. The original store supplies one claim, append/fsync, immutable completion, recovery minimum and poison semantics.

Successful publication requires exact completed readback. Existing exact bytes are idempotent; changed bytes reject. Pending or uncertain post-claim state never becomes a new claim or repaired completion.
No credentials, role signatures, observed outcomes, frozen trust, generation, budget, cost or selection validators are fabricated or relaxed.
